nations.name: Chicken Ranch Rancheria Me-Wuk Indians of California
also: Chicken Ranch Rancheria of Me-Wuk Indians of California
nations.lands: Sierra Nevada foothills, near Jamestown, Tuolumne County, California

facts.text: The Tribe's 2020 wetland plan recounts establishment by Secretary Order in 1908 and termination under the California Rancheria Termination Act in 1958.

source.title: Chicken Ranch Rancheria 2020 Wetland Program Plan
source.publisher: Chicken Ranch Rancheria of Me-Wuk Indians of California; hosted by US EPA

facts.evidence: was established in 1908 by Secretary Order

facts.text: The September 2020 wetland plan makes understanding wetland locations and health a priority before major development on Tribal lands.

source.title: Chicken Ranch Rancheria 2020 Wetland Program Plan
source.publisher: Chicken Ranch Rancheria of Me-Wuk Indians of California; hosted by US EPA

facts.evidence: understand the location and health of the wetlands

facts.text: On November 5, 2026, the Tribe announced three climate fellows supporting Suchumumu Tribal Farm, composting, food recovery and environmental education.

source.title: Chicken Ranch Rancheria Welcomes Three Tribal Climate Fellows to Support Suchumumu Tribal Farm and Climate Action
source.publisher: Chicken Ranch Rancheria Me-Wuk Indians of California

facts.evidence: Fellows support composting and edible food recovery efforts

facts.text: On November 23, 2026, the Tribe reported a $500,000 contribution toward completion of a youth sports pavilion in Tuolumne County.

source.title: Chicken Ranch Rancheria Donates $500,000 to Support Completion of Youth Sports Foundation Pavilion
source.publisher: Chicken Ranch Rancheria Me-Wuk Indians of California

facts.evidence: to support the completion of the new indoor sports pavilion
